tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search published jobs on the Workable job board.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the full details of a single published job by its advertising UID.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Get the full profile of a company by its id (Workable UUID or database _id), including open job listings.

tools.name: get_job_locations
tools.description: List city/country pairs where jobs are published. Optionally filter by a partial city or country name. Supports pagination via after_key.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get your candidate profile: name, contact details, headline, summary, resume, education and experience.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Update your candidate profile: name, phone, location, education, and work experience.

tools.name: get_my_applications
tools.description: List your submitted job applications, most recent first, paginated. Each item includes jobOpen, indicating whether the job is still open, and isWithdrawable, indicating whether the application can be withdrawn via the withdraw_application tool. tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.description: Get personalized job recommendations for you. Recommendations are matched to your profile (skills, education, experience) and exclude jobs you have already applied to. If your profile is incomplete, recommendations fall back to jobs near your location.

tools.name: get_recent_searches
tools.description: List popular/recent job search terms, tailored to your last known location, with a URL to run each search.

tools.name: withdraw_application
tools.description: Withdraw one of your submitted job applications by its application id. This action cannot be undone from here.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_applications, get_recent_searches · Private data: get_company, get_my_profile · Public sink: get_my_applications · Destructive: get_recent_searches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_applications, get_recent_searches · Private data: get_company, get_my_profile · Public sink: get_my_applications · Destructive: get_recent_searches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
